message:
Create a small runnable local tool in this workspace.

Deliverables:
1. hello_tool.py: standard-library CLI. It accepts one optional name argument and prints "Hello, <name>!". Default name is "World".
2. README.md: include install/run instructions and sample output.
3. Run a real smoke test: python hello_tool.py Codex.
4. Final visible answer must summarize files created and the smoke-test result.

Constraints: no external services, no pseudocode, no TODO-only files.
